How to use this book

IMPULSE LEARNING CENTER
1. Read the question

Read each question aloud. Check new words in the Words & phrases box.

2. Use a starter

Begin your answer with an answer starter, then add your own idea.

3. Say more

Give 2–3 sentences: answer + reason (because…) + example.

4. Write it down

Write a short answer on the line under each question.

Three kinds of lessons

Speaking

Everyday questions about you, your life and your country.

Speaking & Writing

Real-life language: greetings, shops, travel, reviews.

Video

Questions connected to the unit video topic.

Classroom phrases

Can you repeat that, please?Takrorlay olasizmi?
How do you say … in English?… inglizcha qanday bo‘ladi?
What does … mean?… nimani anglatadi?
Can you speak more slowly, please?Sekinroq gapira olasizmi?
Sorry, I don’t know.Kechirasiz, bilmayman.

Make your answer longer

ShortYes, I have.
BetterYes, I’ve got a cat.
BestYes, I’ve got a cat. Her name is Mimi and she’s very friendly. I play with her every evening.

Linking words

andbutbecausesoalsousuallyfor exampleI think…

Speaking checklist

  • I speak in full sentences.
  • I give a reason with because.
  • I look at the person and speak clearly.
  • I don’t stop when I make a mistake.

1-minute talk

Talk for one minute without stopping. Use these questions to help you:

  • What are you going to do this weekend?
  • Are you going to change anything in your life soon?
  • Do you like going to cafés?
